C0478.title: SPD Bank Mastercard Cardholders Hit by Overseas Fraud, Receive Point Compensation
C0478.summary: In September 2025, multiple SPD Bank Mastercard 'Priceless World Card' users reported unauthorized overseas transactions. The bank offered some affected customers compensation including reward points, transaction refunds, and fee waivers.
